entries.headline: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer launches on Steam on November 16
entries.summary: NTT Solmare and Good Smile Company announced that dark-romance visual novel Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer will launch for PC via Steam on November 16. Developed by Frontwing, it is the first entry in the Sinner's Choice series and focuses on Lucifer, the eldest of the demon brothers.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays the announcement from NTT Solmare and Good Smile Company, confirming the date, PC platform, developer and series position.
entries.timeNote: The report was published on November 8 at 5:31 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Danchi Days feature connects apartment-complex exploration and community through five-senses minigames
entries.summary: An AUTOMATON feature argues that Danchi Days links apartment-complex exploration, resident interactions and five-senses minigames—such as smelling wood, making mud balls and listening to birds—into a story about restoring a summer festival through a child's cycle of sensing, imagining and acting.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON feature provides an independent analysis of the five-senses minigames, resident interactions, summer-festival story and child-centered perspective.
entries.timeNote: The feature was published on November 8 at 1:59 PM Beijing time.

entries.headline: Kick developer interview explains its physics-driven football journey through a Japanese school route
entries.summary: Developer Peter Sörensen told AUTOMATON that Kick is a side-scrolling game about dribbling along a Japanese school route, with its central challenge built around predicting and precisely controlling a physics-driven football. Developed by nospacelost, the game launched for PC via Steam on November 4.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON interview confirms the developer, November 4 PC release, school-route setting and physics-driven ball-control design.
entries.timeNote: The interview was published on November 8 at 12:00 PM Beijing time.
